history.change: Re-baselined to the delivered 1.12.0 content; no v8 copy existed to diff against.
Verdict gains 'interrupted' and 'partial': a killed subagent is not a failed one, and a partial result is not a success.
BrowserTask.controller gains 'switching': while control changes hands nobody drives, and the browser views say so.
Command gains browser.click, browser.key and browser.scroll (with BrowserKey): the user's own input to a live page they drive. Approved by the maintainer, 2026-10-21. All three are human-only.

Command gains browser.keep-signed-in, profile.sign-out and profile.delete, and AppState gains signedInSites (with SignedInSite): the user keeps the sign-in of a browser they drive, and signs out of or deletes it in Settings (WO-030). Approved by the maintainer, 2026-10-22. All three are human-only.

SignedInSite gains signIns (with SiteSignInLabel: id, label, origin), and Command gains sign-in.delete: the sign-ins the broker fills for a signed-in site, listed by label, never a username or password (WO-030, part 2). Keeping one is not a Command: the Settings form sends it straight to the broker through the live adapter's SignInPort, so it never reaches the command log, automation or the app's state. Approved by the maintainer, 2026-10-22. sign-in.delete is human-only.

BrowserTask gains codeRequest (with BrowserCodeRequest: id, origin), and Command gains browser.decline-code: a signed-in site's request for a one-time code, shown on its browser (WO-030, part 3). The code itself is not a Command and never state: the browser view sends it straight to the broker through the live adapter's CodePort, which types it into the page once. Approved by the maintainer, 2026-10-23. browser.decline-code is human-only.
